body:
happened once more again had godot engine open and then through nemo file manager I've opened ui.tscn simple scene in Kate and edited it there (left kate editor with opened ui.tscn scene open for longer to copy paste scene code and went back to Godot and it froze when I tried to click on scene hierarchy to select a node. 

If still you can't reproduce the 'freezing error' try opening one more of your small godot project on the side (just have it open nothing more and try to do all the steps I did here on my sample project).

Crashed again this time I have exact steps to reproduce the error:
**Happens both when godot-mono is ran under x11 and when ran with godot-mono --display-driver wayland**

1) open attached project from godot app picker.
2) go to file system part > right click onto ui.tscn > chose "Show in file manager" (nemo in my case)

Next step depends if you have Fisk2.csproj.old or not in filesystem (follow 3a if you do have .old file, 3b if not)
3a) open Fisk2.csproj.old in Kate text editor > copy only first line <Project Sdk="Godot.NET.Sdk/4.6.0"> -> close .old file
3a.2) from within file manager open Fisk2.csproj with Kate and paste that single line instead of first line <Project Sdk="Godot.NET.Sdk/4.7.0-dev"> that was there before.
3a.3) save and exit Fisk2.csproj from Kate and ALT + TAB to GODOT project and try to click on any node in scene hierarchy of Fisk2 opened project.  --> GODOT FREEZES

if you don't yet have .old file on your project filesystem:
3b) open Fisk2.csproj and replace first line <Project Sdk="Godot.NET.Sdk/4.7.0-dev"> with <Project Sdk="Godot.NET.Sdk/4.6.0"> , save & exit Kate text editor
3b.2) ALT + TAB to GODOT editor,  CTRL + S for good measure in godot editor and quit godot 
3b.3) Open GODOT and pick Fisk2 project again -> Now you have .old file in project file structure (if by this point you haven't had godot freeze treat this step as one time setup and just try to reproduce GODOT freeze error following 1 > 2 > 3a steps only.

If after all this freeze error still doesn't occur try few more times same steps , try waiting with Kate editor open for longer , or even try same steps but also with this simple app/scene running in debug.

Under wayland godot editor just FREEZES but state can be restored.

Final minimal reproduce steps:

1) Open godot project 
2) FileSystem (right click) (show in file manager) > open ui.tscn in Kate (or other external text editor)
3) Either a) Select all (CTRL +A)  or b) start modifying .tscn file but don't save it
4) ALT + TAB into Godot Editor -> now it's frozen 

If you're on wayland you can unfroze it by exiting external text editor and file manager and wait some seconds , try dragging godot editor window and minimize maximize.

If you're on x11-compatibility for wayland then there's point of no return - to exit the app you have to kill the process.
